~Might be resolved when https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/105595 is in the next dev build, since from my limited understanding I'm guessing it might be trying to use Accessibility features when there is no screenreader.~

Nevermind, seems that PR is already  in v4.5.dev4, and I could reprdouce it there.
If you are not using screen reader, it should be already fixed by https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/106783
No, I was not able to reproduce it, it likely related to window creation and destruction in a rapid succession (tooltip), which might be removed before pending note tree updates are done.

Just tested on  Godot 4.5 dev5 and unfortunately can still reproduce crash 100% consistently. 

## New info
- **Crash occurs whether Orca Screenreader is enabled or not.**
- Crash occurs on all Debugger tab menu items (except the first default "stack trace", which it starts on).

![Showing all the godot debug tabs](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e2209464-b234-4fea-a40f-8260b956aff9)

I have a vanilla install of Fedora (was Fedora 40 originally, upgraded to 41). Orca was part of the install.

### Orca logs

There seems to be a warning when enabling ORCA that AT-SPI socket doesn't exist. This might just be a temporary issue (its a warning after all, not a crash), but I did make a note of it.
```
(orca:19850): dbind-WARNING **: 18:43:19.878: AT-SPI: Unable to open bus connection: Failed to connect to socket /run/user/1000/at-spi2-3VXR72/socket: No such file or file catalog
```

This initial warning is not is not connected to Godot, but the subsequent warnings are after launching Godot.
I'm Including them here just in-case it could be helpful.

### Question
Could this be a simple directory path issue?
I have no idea where the "runner" part of this path came from: I have no USER named "runner" and no directory called "runner" in /home either!

I just checked my `/etc/passwd` file and I can't find "runner" at all. 

```
thread '<unnamed>' panicked at 
/home/runner/.cargo/registry/src/index.crates.io-1949cf8c6b5b557f/accesskit_unix-0.14.0/src/context.rs:61:78
called `Result::unwrap()` on an `Err` value: InterfaceNotFound
```


Is Godot creating this runner directory in a sandbox? (it might! I don't really know how this works)


Here is what I found when digging around myself in a real user:
```
$ cd /home/benjamin/.cargo/registry/src/index.crates.io-6f17d22bba15001f
$ ls

```

I don't see accesskit_unix-0.14.0 here, but maybe thats expected.

> I just checked my /etc/passwd file and I can't find "runner" at all.

It's the source code path that was used when compiling AccessKit, it won't be on your system.

Today I tried to run [librerama](https://codeberg.org/Librerama/librerama/) with 4.5.beta1 from the project manager.

The game crashes with the same backtrace after leaving the first scene.
I'm facing the same issue in 4.5beta1 on Linux Mint.
